posts.title: A crochet detective story
posts.description: My latest just-for me project is a stripy cardigan worked sideways, and it’s a milestone for me as it’s my very first crocheted sweater. I actually learned to crochet before I learned to knit, but I’m much more experienced with knitting as I’ve spent much more time doing it over the years.

posts.title: New patterns: The Greenery Set
posts.description: The Greenery Set is a trio of hat, cowl, and mitts featuring a rich texture of cable-and-lace leaves, seed stitch, and half-twisted ribbing. posts.title: Project Comfortable: Bereket + Bubble Cardie
posts.description: I’ve been lazy about taking photos in recent months, so I have a bit of a backlog of makes to show off - but here they are! I’m splitting them up into two groups with the first being my knitting FOs and current main WIP, and my sewing projects will follow in a post of their own.
